gold_note: Maniraptoran summary tree, read by eye. The Paraves triangle is one tip. Polytomies: Mononykus, Shuvuuia and Albinykus; the three therizinosaurs; Caudipteryx, Avimimus and the rest; and the four oviraptorids from Ingenia to Conchoraptor. Maniraptora, Alvarezsauroidea, Therizinosauria and Oviraptorosauria each sit beside a bracket on the stem of the node they name and are kept. 21 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 3, 3, 4 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels.
